messages:
Maya Rhee: Quick sync — final social push for the Benchmark report + webinar next Wed. Need final copy, hero assets, and lead-routing details. Can we lock the schedule today?

Connor Liu: I got the charts done. PNG + SVG + a short animated GIF of the latency curve. Can hand off by 3pm PT. Will add alt text for accessibility.

Priya Patel: Draft copies ready. Two headline variants for X (A/B):
- A: "New Benchmark: 10x median latency savings across common LLM workloads"
- B: "How teams cut per-token cost in half — lessons from our benchmark"

LinkedIn long-post is a 5-bullet explainer + CTA to register for the webinar and download the full report. CTA options: "Register for webinar" or "Get the full report" — recommend webinar for the first post.

Evan Greene: Timing suggestions: X main post at 9:30am ET, re-share at 3pm ET. LinkedIn long post at 11am ET. If we want to A/B the headline on X, schedule two adjacent tweets as variants and track clicks.

Evan Greene: Also assign someone to monitor first 60min for high-engagement replies and to escalate any product/ops questions to eng. If we expect traffic to landing, ensure rate-limits on the form are bumped.

Sam Torres: Routing notes: add UTM params for source=social & campaign=benchmark-apr. HubSpot form id: `hs_form_8341` — map to list `webinar-benchmark-042`. SDR tag on inbound: `benchmark-interest`. SDR team will do 24hr follow-up cadence. I can own lead triage for 48 hrs post-launch.

Connor Liu: uploaded assets to /marketing/assets/benchmark_apr/ — files: hero_v1.png, chart_latency.gif, report_page1.svg. Link: https://files.redwood/benchmark_apr_preview (preview only).

Priya Patel: Copy variants attached in the doc: https://docs.redwood/copy/benchmark-social — please add reactions to the exact headline you prefer. Also added two CTA blurbs: short (for X) and long (for LinkedIn).

Maya Rhee: Scheduling snippet for Buffer (example):
```
# X post A
2026-04-01T13:30:00Z -> X (headline A + hero_v1.png + short CTA)
# X post B (resurface)
2026-04-01T19:00:00Z -> X (resurface + gif)
# LinkedIn long
2026-04-01T15:00:00Z -> LinkedIn (long post + report link)
```

Evan Greene: LGTM. Who will schedule in Buffer/Share?

Connor Liu: I can queue them once copy is locked and Priya confirms final CTA.

Priya Patel: I prefer headline B on X (cost angle), but put webinar CTA first on LinkedIn. Will drop final copy by 2:30pm PT.

Maya Rhee: Important: we want a soft script for replies. If folks ask about model names or infra, reply with the standard line and link to the appendix: "See model + infra notes in the report (appendix A) — happy to connect with the team for details." Mark as `reply-template-A`.

Sam Torres: Confirmed: HubSpot form + UTM + list created. SDR playbook: email within 24 hours, LinkedIn connection attempt at 72 hours, tag as `benchmark-warm`.

social-bot: Preview generated -> https://tiny.redwood/benchmark-preview. Scheduled reminders set for send-window 5m before publish. :rocket:

Maya Rhee: Ok team — final check: Connor deliver assets by 3pm PT, Priya final copy by 2:30pm PT, Connor to queue posts, Sam owns lead routing. Evan monitors the hour after publish and will escalate if needed. If that timeline holds, I'll press publish in Buffer after QA. :thumbsup:

Connor Liu: On it.

Priya Patel: On it.

Evan Greene: I'll be watching.

Sam Torres: I'll stand by for inbound triage.

Maya Rhee: Thanks everyone — will post the final scheduled times here once queued.
